note: Vessel tree, batch 1: femoral artery system and the pelvic arteries that feed it. Both sides (S = Left or Right). Diameters in mm (start, end). terminal = the only kind of end that may taper. Written for scripts/build-leg-vessels.mjs and scripts/check-leg-vessel-tree.mjs.

vessels.at: aortic bifurcation (L4)

origin.en: Abdominal aorta at its bifurcation, in front of the fourth lumbar vertebra
origin.zh: 腹主動脈分叉處，位於第四腰椎前方

course.en: Runs down and outwards along the medial border of psoas major, in front of the common iliac vein, and divides in front of the sacroiliac joint
course.zh: 沿腰大肌內側緣向下外側行，位於髂總靜脈前方，在薦髂關節前方分為內、外兩支

supply.en: Pelvis and lower limb, through its two terminal branches
supply.zh: 經兩條終支供應骨盆與下肢

vessels.at: division of the common iliac artery, in front of the sacroiliac joint

origin.en: Common iliac artery

course.en: Short trunk that runs down into the pelvis in front of the sacroiliac joint and splits into an anterior and a posterior division
course.zh: 短幹，在薦髂關節前方向下進入骨盆，分為前幹與後幹

supply.en: Pelvic wall and viscera, gluteal region and perineum
supply.zh: 骨盆壁與盆腔臟器、臀區與會陰

vessels.at: division of the common iliac artery

origin.en: Common iliac artery

course.en: Runs along the medial border of psoas major to the midpoint between the anterior superior iliac spine and the pubic symphysis, where it passes under the inguinal ligament
course.zh: 沿腰大肌內側緣下行，至髂前上棘與恥骨聯合連線中點，經腹股溝韌帶深面

supply.en: Lower limb; gives the deep circumflex iliac and inferior epigastric arteries just above the inguinal ligament
supply.zh: 下肢；在腹股溝韌帶上方分出旋髂深動脈與腹壁下動脈

vessels.at: deep to the inguinal ligament

origin.en: External iliac artery, at the inguinal ligament
origin.zh: 外髂動脈，於腹股溝韌帶處

course.en: Descends in the femoral triangle (lateral to the femoral vein, medial to the femoral nerve), then in the adductor canal, and passes through the adductor hiatus to become the popliteal artery
course.zh: 在股三角內下行（位於股靜脈外側、股神經內側），再入內收肌管，穿內收肌裂孔後改稱膕動脈

supply.en: Anterior and medial thigh; continues as the popliteal artery
supply.zh: 大腿前側與內側；延續為膕動脈

relations.rule: nerve lateral to artery at the femoral triangle

vessels.at: 3–5 cm below the inguinal ligament

origin.en: Femoral artery, 3–5 cm below the inguinal ligament
origin.zh: 股動脈，腹股溝韌帶下方 3–5 公分

course.en: Runs backwards and laterally behind the femoral vessels and deep to adductor longus, close to the femur, giving the circumflex femoral and perforating arteries; its end is the fourth perforating artery
course.zh: 向後外側行經股血管後方、內收長肌深面，貼近股骨，依序分出旋股動脈與穿動脈，終末為第四穿動脈

supply.en: Main blood supply of the thigh muscles and the femur
supply.zh: 大腿肌肉與股骨的主要血液供應

vessels.at: deep femoral artery, near its origin

origin.en: Deep femoral artery (sometimes the femoral artery)
origin.zh: 股深動脈（有時來自股動脈）

course.en: Winds backwards round the medial side of the femoral neck between pectineus and iliopsoas, then passes above quadratus femoris to the trochanteric fossa
course.zh: 繞股骨頸內側向後，經恥骨肌與髂腰肌之間，再越過股方肌上緣到轉子窩

supply.en: Femoral head and neck (retinacular arteries) and neighbouring muscles
supply.zh: 股骨頭、頸（支持帶動脈）與鄰近肌肉

vessels.at: deep femoral artery, near its origin

origin.en: Deep femoral artery

course.en: Passes laterally between the divisions of the femoral nerve, behind sartorius and rectus femoris, and divides into ascending, transverse and descending branches
course.zh: 向外側經股神經分支之間、縫匠肌與股直肌深面，分為升支、橫支與降支

supply.en: Muscles of the front and lateral thigh and the hip joint region
supply.zh: 大腿前側與外側肌肉及髖關節周圍

vessels.en: Ascending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
vessels.at: lateral circumflex femoral artery

origin.en: Lateral circumflex femoral artery

course.en: Ascends laterally beneath sartorius and rectus femoris towards the anterior superior iliac spine
course.zh: 在縫匠肌與股直肌深面向外上走，朝髂前上棘

supply.en: Tensor fasciae latae and the muscles round the hip; anastomoses with the superior gluteal artery
supply.zh: 闊筋膜張肌與髖周肌肉；與臀上動脈吻合

vessels.en: Transverse branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
vessels.at: lateral circumflex femoral artery

origin.en: Lateral circumflex femoral artery

course.en: Runs laterally through vastus lateralis and winds round the femur below the greater trochanter
course.zh: 向外側穿過股外側肌，繞過大轉子下方的股骨

supply.en: Vastus lateralis; joins the cruciate anastomosis of the thigh
supply.zh: 股外側肌；參與大腿十字吻合

vessels.en: Descending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
vessels.at: lateral circumflex femoral artery
vessels.guide: Descending branch of {s} lateral circumflex femoral artery

origin.en: Lateral circumflex femoral artery

course.en: Descends on the front of the thigh between vastus lateralis and rectus femoris, with the nerve to vastus lateralis, towards the knee
course.zh: 沿大腿前面在股外側肌與股直肌之間下行，伴股外側肌神經，朝向膝部

supply.en: Vastus lateralis and the lateral side of the knee (anastomoses with the genicular arteries)
supply.zh: 股外側肌與膝外側（與膝動脈吻合）

vessels.at: femoral artery, 1–2 cm below the inguinal ligament

origin.en: Femoral artery, 1–2 cm below the inguinal ligament
origin.zh: 股動脈，腹股溝韌帶下方 1–2 公分

course.en: Runs laterally in the subcutaneous tissue along the inguinal ligament towards the anterior superior iliac spine
course.zh: 在皮下沿腹股溝韌帶向外側，朝髂前上棘

supply.en: Skin and superficial fascia of the groin and lower abdominal wall
supply.zh: 腹股溝與下腹壁的皮膚和淺筋膜

vessels.at: external iliac artery, just above the inguinal ligament

origin.en: External iliac artery, just above the inguinal ligament
origin.zh: 外髂動脈，腹股溝韌帶上方

course.en: Runs laterally along the inguinal ligament to the anterior superior iliac spine, then along the inner lip of the iliac crest
course.zh: 沿腹股溝韌帶向外側至髂前上棘，再沿髂嵴內唇走行

supply.en: Iliacus and the muscles of the lower abdominal wall
supply.zh: 髂肌與下腹壁肌肉

vessels.at: deep femoral artery

origin.en: Deep femoral artery

course.en: Pierces adductor brevis and adductor magnus close to the linea aspera and reaches the posterior compartment of the thigh
course.zh: 貼近股骨粗線穿過內收短肌與內收大肌，到達大腿後區

supply.en: Hamstrings, adductor magnus and the femoral shaft
supply.zh: 膕繩肌、內收大肌與股骨幹

vessels.at: deep femoral artery

origin.en: Deep femoral artery

course.en: Pierces adductor brevis and adductor magnus close to the linea aspera and reaches the posterior compartment of the thigh
course.zh: 貼近股骨粗線穿過內收短肌與內收大肌，到達大腿後區

supply.en: Hamstrings, adductor magnus and the femoral shaft
supply.zh: 膕繩肌、內收大肌與股骨幹

vessels.at: deep femoral artery

origin.en: Deep femoral artery

course.en: Pierces adductor brevis and adductor magnus close to the linea aspera and reaches the posterior compartment of the thigh
course.zh: 貼近股骨粗線穿過內收短肌與內收大肌，到達大腿後區

supply.en: Hamstrings, adductor magnus and the femoral shaft
supply.zh: 膕繩肌、內收大肌與股骨幹

vessels.en: Fourth perforating artery (end of the deep femoral artery)
vessels.zh: 第四穿動脈（股深動脈終末）
vessels.at: end of the deep femoral artery

origin.en: Terminal part of the deep femoral artery

course.en: Pierces adductor magnus near the lower end of the linea aspera and ends in the hamstrings
course.zh: 在股骨粗線下端附近穿過內收大肌，止於膕繩肌

supply.en: Hamstrings; anastomoses with the popliteal branches
supply.zh: 膕繩肌；與膕動脈分支吻合

vessels.at: posterior division of the internal iliac artery

origin.en: Posterior division of the internal iliac artery

course.en: Passes backwards between the lumbosacral trunk and the first sacral nerve and leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen above piriformis, then divides into superficial and deep branches
course.zh: 向後穿過腰薦幹與第一薦神經之間，經梨狀肌上緣出大坐骨孔，分為淺支與深支

supply.en: Gluteal muscles (maximus, medius, minimus) and tensor fasciae latae
supply.zh: 臀大肌、臀中肌、臀小肌與闊筋膜張肌

vessels.en: Superficial branch of superior gluteal artery
vessels.at: superior gluteal artery
vessels.guide: {S} superficial branch of superior gluteal artery

origin.en: Superior gluteal artery

course.en: Enters the deep surface of gluteus maximus
course.zh: 進入臀大肌深面

supply.en: Gluteus maximus and the overlying skin
supply.zh: 臀大肌與其表面皮膚

vessels.en: Deep branch of superior gluteal artery
vessels.at: superior gluteal artery
vessels.guide: {S} deep branch of superior gluteal artery

origin.en: Superior gluteal artery

course.en: Runs between gluteus medius and gluteus minimus
course.zh: 走在臀中肌與臀小肌之間

supply.en: Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and the hip joint
supply.zh: 臀中肌、臀小肌與髖關節

vessels.at: anterior division of the internal iliac artery

origin.en: Anterior division of the internal iliac artery

course.en: Passes between the second and third sacral nerves and leaves the pelvis below piriformis, then enters gluteus maximus
course.zh: 穿過第二與第三薦神經之間，經梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，進入臀大肌

supply.en: Gluteus maximus, the upper hamstrings and the sciatic nerve (artery to the sciatic nerve)
supply.zh: 臀大肌、膕繩肌上部與坐骨神經

vessels.at: anterior division of the internal iliac artery

origin.en: Anterior division of the internal iliac artery

course.en: Leaves the pelvis below piriformis, curves round the ischial spine and returns to the perineum through the lesser sciatic foramen
course.zh: 經梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，繞坐骨棘，再經坐骨小孔回到會陰

supply.en: Perineum and external genitalia
supply.zh: 會陰與外生殖器

vessels.at: anterior division of the internal iliac artery

origin.en: Anterior division of the internal iliac artery

course.en: Runs along the lateral wall of the pelvis with the obturator nerve and vein and leaves through the obturator canal, then divides into anterior and posterior branches
course.zh: 沿骨盆側壁與閉孔神經、閉孔靜脈同行，經閉孔管出骨盆，分為前支與後支

supply.en: Adductor muscles of the thigh and the head of the femur (acetabular branch)
supply.zh: 大腿內收肌群與股骨頭（髖臼支）
